newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin leaves sanatorium for country residence.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin leaves sanatorium for country residence.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin left the Barvikha sanatorium near Moscow on Wednesday for his official residence in the same government compound, a Kremlin spokesman told Reuters.
Yeltsin, 65, who has been convalescing after heart bypass surgery on November 5, has been at Barvikha since November 22.
Doctors have said the president, who is already working several hours a day, should be back at his desk in the Kremlin this month.
Medical staff say he is recovering well from the quintuple bypass operation to relieve clogged cardiac arteries.
